s: Dine tepilla mi"baruk sheamar" ad "yishtabbach" ubo y"g seipim: tiqqenu lomar pesuqe dezimra bekol yom, dehaynu mi"tehilla ledavid" ad "kol hanneshama tehallel vegav", kede lesadder shibcho shel maqom baruk hu techilla veachar kak yitpallel, ki ken asa mosheh rabbenu alayv hashshalom bitpillato, sheamar techilla "atta hachillota leharot et abdeka et godleka vego'" veachar kak "ebera na vego'", ukede laamod bitpilla mittok simcha shel mitzva. Velamma bacharu bemizmorim ellu? Lepi sheameru: kol haomer tehilla ledavid g' peamim bekol yom — mubtach lo shehu ben olam habba, veaggab oto mizmor tiqqenu lomar ad siyyum tehillim sheyyesh sham y' peamim "haleluyah" keneged asara hillulim shebbeseper tehillim: nitztzuach, niggun, shir veku'. Vetiqqenu beraka lipnehem uleacharehem, lipnehem — "baruk sheamar", veacharehem — "yishtabbach". Veyesh meqomot shennohagin lehosip "hodu laHashem qiru bishmo" kaasher hu katub beseper dibre hayyamim, lepi sheddavid qebao leomrah bekol yom lipne haaron. U"mizmor letoda", lepi shekkol hashshirot atidin lehibbatel chutz mi"mizmor letoda", velaken yesh limshok oto bingina. Venohagin bimdinot ellu shello leomrah beshabbat veyom tob, mippene sheen toda qereba bahen. Veken bime happesach en toda qereba mishshum chametz shebbah. Veken beereb pesach, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tk"t. Veken beereb yom kippur, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tr"d. Abal bet' beab omerim oto, shehare bizman shebbet hammiqdash haya qayyam hayu maqribin toda gam bet' beab. Veyesh shemmosipin od pesuqim acherim, vekol maqom umaqom lepi minhago. Veyesh nohagin lomar kol happesuqim vehammizmorim shemmosipim qodem "baruk sheamar". Ubimdinot ellu nohagin leomram achar "baruk sheamar", kede sheyyihyeh lekullam beraka lipnehem uleacharehem. Venohagin lehosip qodem birkat "yishtabbach": "vaybarek david" ad "mehalelim leshem tiparteka" kaasher hu beseper dibre hayyamim, "vibareku shem kebodeka" ad shirat hayyam kaasher hu beseper nechemya, veshirat hayyam, lepi shekkol otam t"v leshonot shel shebach hassedurot debirkot yishtabbach derashum chakamim mittok shirat hayyam umittok otan pesuqim shel "vaybarek david":

Yesh lomar "baruk sheamar" beniggun ubinima, ki hu shir naeh venechmad. Vetiqqenuhu anshe keneset haggedola al yede iggeret shennopla min hashshamayim umetzauhu katub bo, veyesh bah p"z tebot, vesimano "rosho ketem paz". Veqibbelu leomro meummad apillu beyachid. Veal pi hassod yesh lomar: "bepeh ammo" velo "bepi ammo", "battishbachot" bechiri"q hattay"v. Veyeechoz beb' tzitzit shebbattallit shehen keneged panayv bishat amirat "baruk sheamar":

Im siyyem "baruk sheamar" qodem shessiyyem hashsheliach tzibbur — oneh acharayv amen. Veen amen zeh chashub hepseq ben pesuqe dezimra libraka shellipnehem, lepi sheggam amen shebach hu ukeen zimra (abal im adayin lo siyyem habberaka — lo yaaneh, sheen mapsiqin beemtza shum beraka apillu baaniyyat amen, ella beamen shel "hael haqqadosh" veshel "shomea tepilla" bilbad, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman s"v). Veyesh mi sheomer shebberaka zo shel "baruk sheamar" hoil veenah muzkeret battalmud — mapsiqin bah lekol amen. Veim siyyem im hashsheliach tzibbur bebat achat — yesh omerim shello yaaneh amen, mippene shehaoneh amen achar birkotayv — hare zeh megunneh. Veap sheyyesh maqom lachaloq velomar sheen zeh oneh amen achar birkotayv, sheal kol panim hu oneh achar birkat hashsheliach tzibbur — ap al pi ken yesh lachosh ledibrehem. Umikkol maqom, im siyyem im hashsheliach tzibbur bebat achat birkat "yishtabbach" vekayyotze bah mehabberakot sheyyesh meqomot nohagin laanot bah amen apillu achar birkot atzmo kemo sheyyitbaer bimqoman, ap shebbimdinot ellu en nohagin ken laanot achar birkat atzmo, mikkol maqom keshemmesayyem im hashsheliach tzibbur bebat achat — yakol laanot. Vehu haddin im hashsheliach tzibbur siyyem beraka achat vehu siyyem beraka acheret — yakol laanot achar birkat hashsheliach tzibbur, apillu siyyem hu beraka sheen onin alayv achar birkat atzmo ledibre hakkol:

Tzarik lizzaher millehapsiq bedibbur mishsheyyatchil "baruk sheamar" ad sop y"ch, lepi she"baruk sheamar" hi beraka shellipne pesuqe dezimra ve"yishtabbach" beraka leacharehem veasur lehapsiq benehem apillu letzorek mitzva, kemo sheasur lehapsiq biqriat shema ubirkoteha. Uben "yishtabbach" le"yotzer or" — gam ken en lehapsiq, vehammapsiq — abera hi beyado, vechozer alayv meoreke hammilchama, lepi sheppesuqe dezimra nitqenu lehasdir shibcho shel maqom baruk hu qodem hattepilla, vekevan shekken hu — eno bedin ledabber ben siddur hashshebach vehattepilla, ella im ken letzorek mitzva kemo sheyyitbaer besiman n"d. Uben birkot qeriat shema litpilla — asur lehapsiq apillu letzorek mitzva, mippene shetztzarik lismok geulla litpilla:

Usheilat shalom mi"baruk sheamar" ad "yishtabbach" — dinah kemo biqriat shema ubirkoteha, shebben happeraqim — shoel mippene hakkabod umeshib shalom lekol adam, ubaemtza — shoel mippene hayyira umeshib mippene hakkabod, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman s"v. Veellu hen ben happeraqim: ben "baruk sheamar" lehatchalat hammizmorim, uben kol mizmor lachabero, uben sop hammizmorim le"yishtabbach". Upesuqim hamluqqatim sheenam mizmor shalem — yesh mi sheomer shekkol shenayim o shelosha pesuqim hanneemarim kan keseder shehem ketubim bimqomam — dinam kemizmor shalem. Ukeshemmapsiq ben echad lachabero — dino kemapsiq beemtza mizmor. Uben sopam litchillat pasuq acher — dino keben happeraqim, kegon bimdinot ellu me"hodu" ad "amen vehallel laHashem", hu pereq echad ap al pi sheenam mizmor shalem bedibre hayyamim. Veken b' pesuqim "tenu oz vego' nora elohim vego'" ad "baruk elohim" — hem gam ken pereq echad, hoil vehem semukim zeh lazeh bithillim. Veken b' pesuqim "el neqamot vego' hinnase vego'" ad "al geim". Veken g' pesuqim: "napshenu chikketa vego' ki bo vego' yehi chasdeka vego'". Veken g' pesuqim: "yehi shem Hashem vego' mimmizrach vego' ram vego'". Veken b' pesuqim: "baruk Hashem elohim vego' ubaruk shem vego'". Veken mi"vaybarek david" ad "leshem tiparteka", ume"atta hu" ad "bemayim azzim", umi"vayyosha" ad sop hashshira. Abal ben happesuqim sheenam semukim zeh lazeh bithillim — dinam keben happeraqim (abal beemtza pasuq — dino keemtza pasuq shel qeriat shema, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman s"v). Vekol zeh leinyan sheilat shalom, abal leinyan lehapsiq laaniyyat amen — en pesuqe dezimra ubirkoteha domin liqriat shema ubirkoteha, umuttar laanot amen al kol habberakot mi"baruk sheamar" ad "yishtabbach" apillu beemtza hammizmor, veen tzarik lomar ben hammizmorim labberaka shellipnehem o shelleacharehem (lepi sheamen hu gam ken shebach ukeen zimra — eno chashub hepseq bipsuqe dezimra). Veyesh mi sheomer sheapillu beemtza habberaka shellipnehem muttar laanot amen, ap al pi shehi potachat bebaruk vechotemet bebaruk — en lachosh bemah shemmapsiq ben peticha lachatima baaniyyat amen, hoil uberaka zo enah muzkeret battalmud. Veim hu tzarik lehapsiq beemtza pesuqe dezimra — tob sheyyomar "baruk Hashem leolam" ad "vaybarek david" qodem sheyyedabber. Ukesheyyachazor lammaqom sheppasaq — yomar gam ken ellu happesuqim, lepi shehem kemo beraka:

Asur lomar pasuq "mi yemallel geburot Hashem" achar "baruk sheamar" qodem "hodu", mippene shennireh keomer: mi sherotzeh lemallel geburot Hashem ulehashmia kol tehillato — yomar "hodu laHashem vego'", vahare zeh cherup:

Tzarik lehapsiq meat ben "elilim" uben "vaHashem shamayim asa", shello yehe nireh kechozer lemala. Vegam ben "ki" le"kol" yesh pesiq, velaken hakka"p degusha. Uben "haammim" le"elilim" uben "shamayim" le"asa" — tzarik gam ken lehapsiq qetzat shello tibbala hamme"m. Veken bekol me"m shebbesop teba veteba shelleachareha matchelet beale"p o beayi"n — tzarik lizzaher ken, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman s"a:

Tzarik lekavven be"poteach et yadeka" perush hammillot hammotzi bispatayv, veim lo kivven — tzarik lachazor velomar bekavvana, lepi sheiqqar mah sheqqabeu lomar "tehilla ledavid" bekol yom hu mippene shebach shebbepasuq zeh, shehaqqadosh baruk hu hu mashgiach al biryotayv leparnes. Veap akshav sheen anu chozerin bishbil chesron kavvana lepi sheqqarob sheap kesheyyachazor lo yekavven kemo sheyyitbaer besiman q"a, mikkol maqom kevan sheeno ella pasuq echad — chozer, shebbeqal yukal lekavven kesheyyirtzeh:

Nohagin lomar pasuq "vaanachnu nebarek yah" achar "tehilla ledavid" lesayyem be"haleluyah", kede leshalshel "haleluyah" achar "haleluyah", shekkol hammizmorot shelleachareha potechot be"haleluyah" umistayyemot be"haleluyah". Veod, lepi shekkol haomer "tehilla ledavid" mubtach lo shehu ben olam habba, laken omerim acharayv: vaanachnu nizkeh lebarek yah gam laolam habba. Umittaam zeh omerim oto gam bemincha, ap al pi sheen acharayv mizmor haleluyah:

Nohagin likpol "kol hanneshama tehallel yah", lepi shehu sop pesuqe dezimra. Veken pasuq "Hashem yimlok leolam vaed", shehu sop hashshira. Veyesh mosipin pasuq "ki ba sus paroh vego'", sheggam hu mehashshira, ayyen beyoreh dea siman ar"h:

Keshemmaggia li"veatta elohenu modim anachnu lak" o li"vekol qoma lepaneka tishtachaveh" — en lishchot ulehishtachavot sham, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qy"g. Venahagu laamod le"vaybarek david" ad "tiparteka". Veyesh mosipin laamod ad sheomerim "atta hu Hashem haelohim" — rashe tebot "ehyeh", veachar kak yoshebin. Ukesheomerim "veatta moshel bakkol" — notenim tzedaqa meummad:

"Mi kamoka nedar vego'" — hakka"p degusha, abal "mi kamoka baelim" veken "kol atzmotay tomarna Hashem mi kamoka" — haka"p repuya, "yiddemu kaaben" — hakka"p degusha, "am zu gaalta" — hag' degusha, shekkak hu bammesorot. Veken bishar dagush verapeh — tzarik lizzaher veliqrot kemo shennimsar bammesorot. Velo yerappeh hechazaq velo yechazzeq harapeh, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman s"a:

En omerim hazzemirot bimrutza, ki im benachat milla bemilla kede lekavven bahem yapeh. Veotan sheomerim otam bimrutza (kesheyyesh sham minyan) — lo yapeh hem osim shemmeqatztzerim beshibcho shel maqom bishbil sheilat tzorkam, hayesh moshel sheyyitratztzeh bekak? Vehu haddin leotam shemmekavvenim battepilla bibrakot shehen techinna ubaqqashat tzorke haggup velo babberakot shehen shebach vehodaa lammaqom baruk hu:
